tiktok.caption: Zelle scams stole $1.9 BILLION last year — and banks aren't required to give it back. Here's the legal trap nobody warns you about.

youtube_short.title: Zelle Scams: Banks Keep $1.9B — Legally
title_alternatives: Why Zelle Victims Get Zero Refunds
youtube_short.description:
Zelle is built into your banking app — but it has zero fraud protection. When a scammer tricks you into sending money, federal law calls it 'authorized' and your bank owes you nothing. Last year Americans lost $1.9 billion this way. Here's why scammers specifically ask for Zelle, and what you need to know. #personalfinance #moneytips #scam #banking #zelle
